messages:
Rosa (Partnerships): Quick check-in ahead of next week's marketplace publish. Two things: final asset bundle deadline and embargo fallback plan. Can we lock timelines now?
Ethan (Product Marketing): proposed embargo 08:00 PT Mon. Marketing needs final hero + 2 alt crops (cloud, on-prem) by Fri EOD. SEO meta + short pitch (3 lines) due EOD Sat.
Sam (Cloud Partnerships): Cloud marketplaces (AWS/GCP/Azure) need SKU mapping and integration test signoff. I need billing mapping spreadsheet back by Thu. Also confirming hardware partner will supply 3 validated logos and HSM blurb.
Lina (Comms): press ops wants a single contact list, embargo FAQ, and a 1-paragraph exec quote. I can draft quote placeholders but need partner approval for quotes. Add press embargo window to partner agreement.
Nadia (Legal): quick heads-up 1: partners must submit logo usage approvals and sign the partner addendum. We can't push to marketplaces without signed addendum. If we miss signatures, fallback = soft launch (partner tile hidden) and internal announcement only.
Omar (EngInfra): Staging windows available Fri 09:00PT and Sat 14:00 PT. We'll run the end-to-end deploy including marketplace listing sync. Please add a feature-flag in the listing: `partner_preview: true` for canary. Smoke test will include: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGE" https://staging.marketplace.redwood.ai/api/listings/verify`
QA-Bot: QA: integration tests scheduled Fri 10:30 PT. Test plan uploaded: https://redwood.internal/qa/marketplace-integ-plan
Rosa (Partnerships): Action items recap: 1) Partners: logos + signed addendum by Thu noon PT; 2) Marketing: hero + SEO + draft pitch by Fri EOD; 3) Cloud teams: SKU/billing spreadsheet Thu; 4) Eng: staging + smoke Fri; 5) Comms: embargo FAQ + press list Sat morning. If all green -> 08:00 PT embargo.
Ethan (Product Marketing): also note localization: Spanish + Japanese two-line pitches. Can someone own localization handoff?
Sam (Cloud Partnerships): I'll coordinate localization of marketplace descriptions with partner PMs.
Nadia (Legal): if signatures slip, propose fallback embargo at 14:00 PT same day and internal-only teaser at 08:00. Approvals must be in place for public PR.
Omar (EngInfra): operational fallback: if marketplace sync fails, we will roll a static landing page + press release URL and disable marketplace tiles. I'll prepare a static landing HTML and set a redirect rule.
Lina (Comms): good plan. I'll prepare both versions of the press release (full + marketplace-delayed). Also we need a screenshot pack for press: marketplace tile, partner logo cluster, product screenshot. Can EngOps provide 3:2 resolution images?
Omar (EngInfra): will export high-res screenshots after smoke and post S3 link.
Rosa (Partnerships): timeline tickler: send partner reminder tomorrow 9am PT. Who will ping partners for final logo variants?
Sam (Cloud Partnerships): I'll ping partners now and CC Nadia for legal.
Ethan (Product Marketing): I'll assemble the asset bundle and create a canonical filename schema: `redwood-marketplace-[partner]-assets-v1.zip` and upload to the shared drive.
Rosa (Partnerships): Perfect. Final note: please add the exec watchlist to this thread once you upload assets so I can notify Sales and CS. :rocket:
QA-Bot: Reminder scheduled: Thu 11:00 PT 1 check signatures and assets.
Lina (Comms): I'll post the press embargo checklist by EOD today.
